items.title: November 23, 2026
items.summary: NetApp VolumesAnnouncementThrough December 31, 2026, Google Cloud NetApp Volumes sends email notificationsto the Google group for NetApp Volumes maintenance, in addition toUnified Maintenance alerts.After December 31, 2026, NetApp Volumes no longer sends email notifications tothe Google group, and Unified Maintenance is the only source of plannedmaintenance notifications.For more information, seeMonitor and plan for maintenance events.FeatureGoogle Cloud NetApp Volumes is integrated withUnified Maintenance. This integrationsupports the Flex Unified, Flex File, Standard, Premium, and Extreme servicelevels.You can view upcoming and past planned maintenance events for your storage poolsin Cloud Hub, and track event logs and configure automated alerts in CloudLogging. For more information, seeMonitor and plan for maintenance events.
